arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, native root256/top8/opponent reply64/root followup32, replanned at every atomic action
method: Read only the already-inspected v2 fit ledger. For each recorded root slate, static-only selects the maximum exact post-root score. Reply-only selects the maximum exact post-opponent-reply position score reconstructed from the 16 exported evaluator components, using the same terminal win/loss sentinel, static-score tie-break and candidate order as native search. Full teacher choice is the recorded exact three-turn score argmax. Compare candidate indices and first legal-action indices within the same root state; no policy is run in a new game.
interpretation: Exact opponent-reply information improves fit-state agreement with the exact three-turn teacher over the static root score, especially for root seat0, but it is not sufficient to reproduce more than about73% of first actions on these sampled states. A response-only learned shortcut would also have to approximate the subsequent root followup or prove a fresh game-strength gain despite these omissions. Candidate-plan lengths suggest a bounded multi-action process, not an autonomous student capability.
qualification: Post-hoc descriptive audit of the previously inspected fit window, with repeated states per map and no independent holdout. No new labels, model training, controller, terminal-game comparison, Elo, runtime or Site change. Do not tune a policy or promotion gate on this window.
